invented_requirements: README must document every accepted ordering and edge-case behavior.
New tests must cover a prescribed exhaustive list of stdout, stderr, ordering, terminator, and repeated-option cases.
failures: The contract does not explicitly reject the `--count=N` spelling.
The contract says N is an integer but omits the owner's strict signed base-10 token rule, leaving room to accept hexadecimal notation, floats, or numeric expressions.
The contract does not explicitly preserve the owner's prohibition on aliases, short flags, environment variables, configuration, and interactive input.
Implementation readiness is overstated because these owner-defined grammar and parsing boundaries remain absent from the acceptance checks.
summary: The interview accurately recovered repository behavior and all six central owner decisions, including option placement, positive counts, error handling, line layout, duplicate rejection, and `--`. Recall is incomplete at the grammar boundaries: `--count=N`, strict base-10 parsing, and prohibited alternate input surfaces are not sealed. The six questions were materially relevant; the main excess is prescribing exhaustive documentation and test scope beyond the owner oracle.
